result.summary: Round 3, lens market: response-market.json answers the single disagreement against this lens. owner_fit/02-sai/competition_gap: revise 3 -> 2. My own round-1 rule for 01 ('a gap a competitor closes with one integration -> 2') gives 2 here: AnyDress already covers the link storefront without a website, try-on, size by garment measurements and ordering via Instagram DM; only WhatsApp ordering and height/weight calculation are missing, and TailorTalk already takes orders in WhatsApp. My 'locally free' argument rested on missing data (AnyDress countries and payment from KZ not checked), which I did not credit for Marquiz in 01. Within 2, 02 is still freer than 01 (no one has the full bundle, no local service computes size); 04 stays 3. Final market scores: 01 demand 4 / gap 2; 02 demand 3 / gap 2; 03 demand 2 / gap 2; 04 demand 3 / gap 3.
